doc: Avatar joint <- MHR joint. Rotations: D = G_posed * G_rest^-1 in MHR body axes, which are the avatar axes (+Y up, +Z forward, +X left), so C = I for rotations; camera-frame positions (pred_joint_coords, pred_keypoints_3d) use C = diag(1,-1,-1). 'align' names the bone [avatar child, MHR child] whose posed direction the avatar bone must match (shortest-arc rest alignment, MHR rest direction taken per identity as D^-1 times the posed bone); null means no alignment (leaves: feet, head). The pelvis has three child bones and is aligned as a frame (TRIAD): 'across' (right hip to left hip) exactly, then the spine bone. The avatar ankle takes l_subtalar, not l_foot: MHR's ankle hinge (l_talocrural) and subtalar joint are children of l_foot, so l_foot's own rotation omits plantar flexion and inversion, while l_subtalar's world rotation carries the whole foot (rigid to l_ball within 0.3 deg). c_spine0 sits at pelvis level and is folded into the pelvis (pelvis D = root D; spine1 absorbs c_spine0's motion). left_hand/right_hand have no reviewed MHR counterpart (fingers are below this rig's fidelity): unmapped, so they hold rest relative to the wrist (Q = identity, omitted from the file). The wrist bone is aimed with the middle-finger base as a proxy child. Every unmapped joint is a leaf, so the even-share chain rule of design 5.3 is never needed by this map.
